notes:
Joinville (SC) urban transit is BUS-ONLY - no metro/light-rail/BRT/suburban-rail exists, so route_type=3 throughout; the metro-first directive does not apply. Gidion operates the south zone (~117 lines, sister operator Transtusa runs the north zone).

SOURCES: The named schedule pages are all JS/SPA-rendered and gated. gidion.com.br/urbano only links out to onibus.info and gives aggregate stats (117 lines, 4230 daily schedules). onibus.info is an AngularJS SPA and its backend /api/ endpoints return HTTP 403 Forbidden without the app's auth headers, so no stop/terminal JSON could be pulled. The joinville.sc.gov.br 2022 route-map PDF and horariodeonibus/moovit pages carry no machine-readable timetables. Route inventory context (line 0702 Itinga/Norte longest, 0700 Sul/Centro shortest, popular 0300/0700/1226) came from Moovit via WebSearch.

WHAT THE FEED IS BUILT FROM: OpenStreetMap. A route=bus relation query over the Joinville bbox returned 223 relations, 78 tagged operator=Gidion, each with a real line ref + name matching Gidion's system (0700 Sul/Centro, 0300 Itaum/Centro, 0600/0601 Guanabara/Centro, 0200 Norte/Sul, 1602 Sao Marcos, the 7000-series Eixo Sul/Itinga direct lines, etc.). 780 highway=bus_stop nodes (277 named) were also pulled. Overpass main + kumi mirrors were down; the maps.mail.ru Overpass mirror served the data.

STOP ORDERING METHOD: Only 2 of 78 relations carried explicit ordered stop/platform node members; the other 76 model the route purely as ordered ways (the driven path). I reconstructed ordered stops by concatenating each relation's way geometry into a polyline (orienting segments by connectivity) and snapping every highway=bus_stop within 45 m onto it, ordered by distance-along-line. This recovered ordered stops for 72/78 routes (median 8, 40 routes with >=8). All coordinates are OSM WGS-84 (correct for GTFS).

THIS OUTPUT: To keep the payload emittable I shipped a validated 4-route representative slice - 0700 Sul/Centro, 0600 Guanabara/Centro, 1602 Sao Marcos, 0200 Norte/Sul - with both directions x 3 service days (WD/SAT/SUN) = 24 trips, 31 stops (Terminal Central platforms 8025*, Terminal Norte platforms 8164* named from OSM; other stops are stop-position nodes labelled Parada lat,lon since OSM did not name them). The full pipeline produced 62 routes / 278 stops / up to ~1100 trips; that larger table is available programmatically. Referential integrity was asserted (every stop_id/route_id/trip_id resolves).

SERVICE TIMES ARE SYNTHETIC: No operator published first/last bus or headways in any accessible source. Times are even-headway placeholders over realistic Joinville urban spans (WD 05:00-24:00 ~20min, SAT 05:30-23:30 ~30min, SUN 06:00-23:00 ~40min) with a 3-min inter-stop dwell. Stop identities, ordering and coordinates are real; the clock times are NOT the real timetable. Calendar year set to 2026.
